result.title: Latent Space Jam: Layout Guided Video Synthesis
result.summary: Adding control to video generation often requires training, which demands additional computational resources, data, or architectural changes. We propose a training-free approach that utilizes pretrained video diffusion models to control object layout and motion using coarse layouts. Our method operates in two passes: first, it steers spatiotemporal placement through prompt-guided cross-attention to produce a coarse visual guide; second, this guide conditions the same model to generate a high-quality, layoutconsistent video. The approach enables coordinated motion with strong temporal consistency, supporting diverse trajectories and object interactions without additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms prior work in overlap and trajectory accuracy, as well as visual quality across static, dynamic, and multi-object scene settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的视频扩散控制方法：先用 prompt 引导的 cross-attention 生成粗粒度时空布局引导图，再让同一模型以该引导为条件生成布局一致、时序连贯的视频。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「cross-attention 引导 + 粗引导二次条件生成」的两阶段免训练流程，可供核查注意力结构如何把空间布局写入 latent 状态、以及粗到细的状态精修是否影响 latent 内容一致性，但与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
